name: 1_workflows
description: GHA workflows + ship-engine generator. Source: src/cicd/*.yml + src/scripts/*.sh -> Dist: .github/workflows/*.yml + 1_workflows/dist/scripts/. Owns the runner-image registry.

deploy.note: Outputs are .github/workflows/ and dist/scripts/ — committed to git.

runners_doc: Runner-image registry: arch -> {type, host?, builder_image?}. Migrated from the legacy runners.json that lived under I_cloud-data/ (Step 3, 2026-05-09 — now z_archive). Consumed by 1_workflows/src/scripts/cloud-ship-container-step-build-docker.sh and cloud-ship-ci-builder-dispatch.sh via 2_configs/dist/build-workflows.json (symlinked from 1_workflows/src/build-workflows.json). 2_configs/build.sh aggregates this build.json's runners + probe + dispatch fields into dist/build-workflows.json. amd64 = local GHA/host. arm64 = remote ssh runner on oci-apps (cloud-builder-x-deb-nixhm image, master in III_unix/cb_containers-builders/build.json). Probe retry/backoff lets the engine survive transient SSH timeouts (WG flap, sshd MaxStartups burst).
dispatch_doc: Async build dispatch: engine writes the docker-run command to a remote script, launches it via nohup (detached from the SSH session), and polls a status file. Survives WG flaps / sshd restarts during long builds — the build keeps running on the runner; the engine just reconnects to read status.
